name: Tucana Dwarf (Hubble)
blurb: The Tucana Dwarf, a dwarf spheroidal galaxy at the edge of the Local Group, seen by Hubble.
label: tucana-hubble
story: The Tucana Dwarf is a loose bundle of aging stars at the far edge of the Local Group. It is one of only two dwarf spheroidal galaxies in the Local Group this remote.
